claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemMechanics.composite
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item has always-on held-item bonuses and separate charge-based activated abilities at the same time. The current magic-item surface is an exclusive union of passive or activation, so encoding only one side would be dishonest.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "This staff has 6 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.holding_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive spell-attack bonus applies only while holding this item. Existing passive gates only model armor and weapon-category predicates, not item-specific held-state.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_damage_numeric
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The staff adds a flat bonus to damage rolls made with the weapon form. The current surface can modify attack rolls and AC, but it has no effect atom for weapon damage-roll bonuses.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "...grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_to_object_transform
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form changes the item into a planted tree, later reverts it to staff form, and forces riders on creatures in the tree when it reverts. That is not representable by the existing passive/activation shapes.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "...expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree... While touching the tree and using a Magic action, you return the staff to its normal form. Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff."
